text:
Sam (CS): Kicking off Auriga Labs onboarding thread. Goal: align stakeholders, define minimal success metrics, timeline, and any renewal or procurement risks. Who can do a 25m sync tomorrow?

Ibrahim (Solutions): I can. Quick tech flag: Auriga wants private VPC + IP allowlist. We'll need their peering CIDR and a staging cert. Also note their prod data residency requirement (EU).

Nina (PM): Proposed success metrics: 1) first authenticated API call within 48h of creds, 2) pilot eval set mean utility >=0.75, 3) p95 latency <250ms for pilot. Commercial: if pilot not moved to PO by day 30, renewal risk increases.

Owen (Customer Eng): Enablement plan: 1x 40m quickstart (API + auth) + 1x 30m ops join. I9ll prepare runbook + dashboard link. Prefer Mon/Wed next week mornings.

Liam Hart (Auriga): Thanks. We can provide peering info by EOD Friday. Procurement is slow here9s contact: @Elena (procure). EU residency is mandatory for pilot data; please confirm retention defaults.

Sam (CS): Retention default 30 days for pilots, configurable. We'll note EU-only storage for this workspace.

Ibrahim (Solutions): Tech checklist: request SAML metadata if they want SSO, or we can use API keys for pilot. Example firewall snippet: ```iptables -A OUTPUT -d 203.0.113.5/32 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT```

Nina (PM): Timeline draft: week0: auth & infra; week1: pilot ingest + smoke tests; week2: eval & ops handoff; week3: scale & commercial review. I'll own the progress tracker.

Onboard Bot: Created workspace "auriga-pilot-eu"  https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/auriga-pilot-eu. Access granted to Sam, Ibrahim, Nina, Owen.

Priya Desai (Auriga): We'll aim to have SAML metadata and peering CIDR by Fri. Elena (procure) will start review once SOW is visible. Can we share a draft SOW and the cost estimate?

Sam (CS): Yes, Nina will post SOW draft in workspace. Action items: Ibrahim  firewall/peering template + staging cert request; Owen  create runbook + dashboard; Nina  SOW draft + tracker; Sam  schedule kickoff once dates confirmed.

Owen (Customer Eng): For eval, propose 10 prompts across core flows and an automated harness. Pass criteria: mean utility >=0.75 and no critical safety flags. I'll upload harness.

Nina (PM): Procurement/renewal risk note: propose an interim acceptance milestone at day 14 to unblock billing. I'll add that clause in SOW draft.

Priya Desai (Auriga): Noted. Tue morning works best for the team for the sync.

Sam (CS): OK scheduling Tue 10am PT. I'll send invites and include workspace links and SOW draft when ready. If anyone spots blockers before then, flag here. Thanks all.
